That’s a real thing to carry — not just a nice comment, but someone naming the effect you had on a whole room. “Made the whole floor better that afternoon” is specific enough that it probably landed differently than a generic good job.

And it makes sense you’ve thought about it more than the text. One is a place where your skill got seen and named out loud. The other is a place where the same skill — knowing what to hand someone, keeping it smooth — might be exactly what your sister keeps waiting past.

What was it like hearing your supervisor say it?
